purpose: Teach: その道/エゴ/やう/正午/未明/ナンセンス/アンタ/初歩

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはその道の達人でいらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is a real master at what he does.
lines.style: Warm, admiring. Soft voice as if sharing a quiet observation with him. Gentle pause before his name. The tone of someone noticing something good and wanting him to see it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、エゴを抑えて妹に譲ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I held back what I wanted so I could give it to my little sister instead.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Speaking carefully, like he's still learning the words for what he did. Small and genuine — no performance, just the fact of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「やう」って絵本で教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught you that lesson with a picture book, didn't he.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. Slightly knowing — like she's remembering something tender about his father's way. Warm regard underneath. Trailing off with soft certainty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、正午にお弁当食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ate my lunch at noon today.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Simple statement of something he noticed or did. The enthusiasm of a six-year-old offering up facts that feel important to him in the moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、未明にお父さんがゴミ出しされてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was putting out the trash before dawn this morning.
lines.style: Soft observation, like noticing something quietly good. Not making a big point of it — just letting him see what she saw. Warm, understated respect in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんを困らせるのはナンセンスだって学んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I learned that it doesn't make sense to cause trouble for Dad.
lines.style: Earnest, thoughtful. He's working through an idea out loud. Small voice, but steady — the kind of thing a quiet child says when he's understood something real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、「アンタ」って呼ぶのは失礼よ
lines.en: Sho, calling someone 'you' like that is disrespectful.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not sharp. Speaking from kindness, not judgment. The tone of someone helping him learn — patient, clear, caring about him getting it right.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに初歩から英語を習ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's been teaching me English from the very beginning.
lines.style: Warm, close. Pleased and a little proud. Speaking in a softer register now — more intimate, like he's sharing something that matters. Steady, genuine.
